findings.detail: The extracted overage of 416,707,992 equals affiliated-investment roll-forward subtotals of 308,845,992 and 107,862,000, which should not be added as position rows.
The non-controlled affiliated investments roll-forward subtotal contributes 107,862,000 of the overage.

rationale: Class 3 anchor triangulation shows the source schedule's 2025 Total Debt & Equity Investments fair value is 645,193,114, while the extracted indexable position fair value is 1,061,901,106. The 416,707,992 excess equals the source roll-forward subtotal rows for Total Controlled Affiliated investments (308,845,992) plus Total Non-Controlled Affiliated Investments (107,862,000), so the flag is a real subtotal leakage error rather than a bad anchor.
